integrity: Analytical proof for all quantified parameters; 606 exact rational columns independently reconstructed as optional checks. Self-review only; no independent mathematical audit and no claim of formal certification.
limitations: The bounds are uniform additive estimates for unweighted complements of regular graphs with \(N\ge4r\); constants and sufficient extremizer threshold need not be sharp. No formula for exact global norms or tie breaking, no weighted/irregular extension, and no assertion about arbitrary minimum-norm projections.
title: A local-codegree law for endpoint cut–cycle projections in dense regular complements
